g.text: Slice Loop - Implement, Validate, Diagnose and Re-plan
Read Ticket Issue + branch + relevant evidence
Test-first when useful; bounded delegation optional
Keep all Slices on the Ticket branch
Capture real exit status + failure evidence
Do not weaken assertions or retry blindly
Preserve completed valid work; stop widening patch
Record concise evidence in authoritative Ticket
Escalate test level only for evidenced risk
Slice execution and Ticket delivery are different loops.
Do not commit unrelated changes or start dependent Slices early.
Optional parallel work requires disjoint ownership;
main agent integrates and makes the final judgment.
Tests / raw evidence use rtk proxy.
Passing focused checks do not trigger a full suite by default.
